description: This Java class represents a command object for modifying policy entries within a policy management system in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON representations, and for serializing the command to JSON. The class enforces size validation and provides accessors for the policy ID and entries to be modified.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntries
classes.description: A command class that modifies policy entries within a specific policy, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, validation, and retrieval of policy details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ModifyPolicyEntries instance from a PolicyId, iterable of PolicyEntries, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or object with specified headers.

methods.name: getPolicyEntries
methods.description: Returns the collection of PolicyEntries to be modified.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the command's policy entries to JSON within the specified schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the policy entries resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Helper for building the JSON payload with policy ID and entries.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with updated headers.
